1818| def resolve(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:

1820| 
1821|     ``kind`` is one of ``leave``, ``sensitive``, ``switch``, ``plan``,
1822|     ``clarify``, ``action`` or ``say``.
1823|     """
1824|     stripped = text.strip()
1825|     lowered = _normalise(stripped)
1826| 
1827|     if lowered.strip(" !.?,:;") in LEAVE_WORDS:
1828|         return {"kind": "leave"}
1829| 
1830|     if any(marker in lowered for marker in SENSITIVE_MARKERS):
1831|         return {"kind": "sensitive"}
1832| 
1833|     # The French and Spanish phrasings of the same actions are compared folded:
1834|     # case, diacritics, punctuation and repeated whitespace carry no meaning.
1835|     if _asks_for_sensitive_action(_fold(stripped)):
1836|         return {"kind": "sensitive"}
1837| 
1838|     # A switch prefix may end the sentence, so the line is compared with a
1839|     # trailing space: ``switch to`` still asks for a project key.
1840|     padded = lowered + " "
1841|     for prefix in SWITCH_PREFIXES:
1842|         if padded.startswith(prefix):
1843|             key = _switch_key(stripped, prefix)
1844|             if not key:
1845|                 return {"kind": "clarify", "reason": "clarify_project"}
1846|             return {"kind": "switch", "key": key}
1847| 
1848|     if lowered.strip(" !.?,:;") in PLAN_EXACT:
1849|         return {"kind": "plan", "goal": ""}
1850|     for prefix in PLAN_PREFIXES:
1851|         if lowered.startswith(prefix):
1852|             return {"kind": "plan", "goal": stripped[len(prefix):].strip()}
1853| 
1854|     tokens = stripped.split()
1855|     matched = [
1856|         name for name, words in ACTIONS if any(word in lowered for word in words)
1857|     ]
1858|     if len(matched) > 1:
1859|         return {"kind": "clarify", "reason": "clarify_several"}
1860|     if not matched:
1861|         if _task_id(tokens) is not None:
1862|             # The owner names a task but no action the session can carry out.
1863|             return {"kind": "clarify", "reason": "clarify_action"}
1864|         return {"kind": "say", "text": stripped}
1865| 
1866|     name = matched[0]
1867|     if name in ("pause", "resume"):
1868|         return {"kind": "action", "action": name}
1869| 
1870|     task_id = _task_id(tokens)
1871|     if task_id is None:
1872|         return {"kind": "clarify", "reason": "clarify_task"}
1873|     remarks = ""
1874|     if name == "rework":
1875|         index = next(
1876|             (
1877|                 position
1878|                 for position, token in enumerate(tokens)
1879|                 if token.strip("\"'`.,;:()").lstrip("#") == task_id
